description: Open the Godot editor on the current project and wait until the MCP Loop bridge answers, then return the same fields as godot_status. Does nothing when an editor already runs for the project. Godot is found from the server's --godot / GODOT_BIN, else PATH and the usual install folders (4.5+ required). The project needs the MCP Loop addon installed and enabled. headless: true opens it without a window (no screenshots; for servers and CI). The editor keeps running after the server stops; editor_quit closes editors opened here.

headless.description: Start the editor without a window (default false).

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the bridge (default 120000; the first open of a project imports every asset).

name: editor_launch
title: Open the Godot editor
